blog_sft.title: SFT vs base Qwen3-VL-2B (canonical prompt): 2 wins, 2 phrase misreadings

Failure: SFT points at the leftmost person in the dugout, not the 2nd from the left; base got it.

blog_grpo_v1.title: GRPO v1 vs SFT: free-space wins on Where2Place, relational breaks on Point-Bench

panels.caption: Win: SFT sits on the dresser edge; v1 moves into the free region underneath.
Win: SFT lands off the table edge; v1 lands in the empty tabletop right of the toy tower.
Broke: SFT found the object left of the sink; v1 lands on the bare counter between it and the sink.
Broke: SFT found the vase left of the pink vase; v1 drifts onto the pink vase (the anchor).

blog_grpo_v2.title: GRPO v2 vs SFT: ordinal/relation fixes (RefCOCO, Point-Bench spatial) vs the reasoning transfer gap

panels.caption: Ordinal fixed: SFT picks the 1st sink; v2 picks the 2nd from the left.
Relation fixed: SFT picks the window above the door; v2 picks the window right of the red door.
Transfer gap: both point at a parked bicycle; the answer is the traffic light the car stops for.
Transfer gap: both point at the strap on the player's shoulder, not the drum that makes the music.

blog_grpo_v3.title: GRPO v3 vs SFT: function-style wins, and the counting drift (several points despite 'exactly one point')

panels.caption: Function win: SFT picks the sponge stick; v3 picks a paintbrush (the GT objects).
Near miss fixed: SFT lands just above the pencil case; v3 lands on it.
Drift: prompt asks for exactly one point; v3 emits three, one per apple, and the counting item is scored a hit.
Broke: SFT found the bus in front; v3 points at the black bus itself (the anchor).

blog_grpo_v4.title: GRPO v4 vs GRPO v3: counting with several correct points, plus one non-counting win and one loss

panels.caption: Counting win: v3 gives one point; v4 gives one point per glass, all three inside.
Counting win: v3 gives one point; v4 gives one per car.
Non-counting win: v3 picks a dish on the table; v4 picks the glass of drink.
Lost: v3 hit the free counter space above the drawers; v4 jumps to the top-right corner.
